summary: Max Verstappen won the Belgian Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 6.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Pierre Gasly completing the podium.
Valtteri Bottas made the biggest climb, from P17 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised SAR (5 second time penalty) and HAM (5 second time penalty).
There were 10 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 118 points over Sergio Perez.
